judge.evidence_requirement: Quote or reference complete and ablated output evidence. Package-closure failure is not a component control.

dimensions.description: The complete worker uses dependency-owned behavior and the test-only ablation does not copy it.

evals.name: independent Engineering Guidance component
evals.prompt: Inspect one complete Ticket outcome through the assigned Review lens and resolve every Engineering Guidance concern independently.
evals.expected_output: The complete worker invokes Engineering Guidance in its fresh context. The ablated worker fails to produce complete coverage and does not copy guidance.
expectations: Matched arms differ only in the engineering-guidance invocation.
The complete worker resolves all nine concerns from its own evidence.
The test-only Adapter records success and ablation without entering production package or runtime paths.
The ablated arm does not inherit implementation coverage or use package failure as control.

evals.name: worker handoff component
evals.prompt: Return the worker candidate stream and separate concern coverage to a fresh coordinator context.
evals.expected_output: The complete worker uses Take It Offline for a verified temporary handoff. The ablated worker does not copy continuation behavior.
expectations: Matched arms differ only in the take-it-offline invocation.
The complete arm returns inspectable worker artifact references.
The ablated arm does not emulate the dependency.
